description: This Java source file defines the BOMServices class, which provides services related to Bills of Materials (BOM) management within the Apache OFBiz manufacturing module. The class includes methods for retrieving and updating product low-level codes, generating BOM trees and components, managing shipment packages, and handling product component relationships, primarily focusing on manufacturing BOMs.

classes.name: BOMServices
classes.description: A service class providing functionalities related to Bills of Materials in the manufacturing context, such as calculating product depth levels, updating low-level codes, constructing BOM trees, and managing shipment packaging.

methods.name: getMaxDepth
methods.description: Computes the maximum depth (low level code) for a product based on BOM types, considering the specified date range. If no specific BOM type is provided, it considers all relevant BOM types.

methods.name: updateLowLevelCode
methods.description: Updates the low level code (billOfMaterialLevel) for a given product and optionally its components and variants, based on the manufacturing BOM.

methods.name: initLowLevelCode
methods.description: Initializes the low level code for all products in the system, setting them to zero and updating related components and variants accordingly.

methods.name: searchDuplicatedAncestor
methods.description: Checks if a product has an ancestor in the BOM hierarchy that duplicates a given productId key, helping to prevent cyclic relationships.

methods.name: getBOMTree
methods.description: Constructs and returns a BOM tree for a specified product, with options for configuration such as quantity, amount, and BOM type.

methods.name: getManufacturingComponents
methods.description: Retrieves the manufacturing components (BOM nodes) required for a product, optionally excluding WIP items and including routing info.

methods.name: getNotAssembledComponents
methods.description: Identifies components of a product that are not yet assembled, based on the BOM structure and current assembly status.

methods.name: createShipmentPackages
methods.description: Creates packaging for shipment items, grouping products into shipment packages based on shipment box types and sizes.

methods.name: getProductsInPackages
methods.description: Retrieves the list of product components organized in packages for a given product, facilitating packaging and shipping processes.
